purpose: Run native/opaque executables and Python .pyz tools only inside a strong OS sandbox, block network and host mutation, enforce timeout/resource limits, and avoid silent weak fallback.

requirements.statement: The active Sandbox Launcher self-test succeeds as an executable artifact.
The strong backend isolates native ELF and Python .pyz execution.
Sandboxed targets cannot see host /etc/passwd, open network sockets, or write the host test path.
The launcher uses a strong-default design with no silent weak-subprocess fallback and enforces timeout/resource limits.
